title: The desktop review: tests, fairer bots, a clearer surrender and a sturdier desktop app
notes: Automated tests ship with the desktop package
A seeded simulation batch runner and summary (`npm run sim`, `tests/summarize.js`) report match length percentiles, first blood and first tower, side balance, i
Bots respect pagoda range when chasing
Laners hold their lane through the early game instead of drifting to distant bosses (objective-minded bots still go)
Surrender is now a visible vote
The death recap always names the final blow, even when no damage was recorded
Routine banners no longer stack up: a repeat within 25 seconds, or a small banner queued behind two others, goes to the kill feed
While dead on desktop, arrow keys and edge panning look around and the Center key follows your ally again
Desktop display modes: Fullscreen, Borderless and Windowed. The window remembers its size, position and monitor
Menus and the HUD scale up on 1440p, 4K and ultrawide screens; the main menu and shop fit a 1024×640 window
